description.value: Sacred Mountain Lavender is a boutique lavender farm established in 2001 on the southern slopes of Mount Tuam near Fulford Harbour, Salt Spring Island, growing over 60 varieties of lavender organically across 2.5 acres. The farm distills its own essential oils on-site and produces a range of handcrafted culinary and spa products. Visiting cyclists can take a self-guided tour of the lavender fields, drying room, and distillation equipment, and browse the seasonal farm shop for locally made lavender goods.
